title: A decision brief for a focused next step
subtitle: A private, editable narrative for alignment

slides.title: Name the decision
slides.content: State the choice in one sentence and make the intended outcome visible.

bullet_points.title: Context
bullet_points.description: What changed or made this decision timely?

bullet_points.title: Outcome
bullet_points.description: What should be different after the decision?

bullet_points.title: Owner
bullet_points.description: Who can move the next step forward?

slides.title: Make the trade-off clear
slides.content: Compare the meaningful alternatives without inventing evidence or hiding constraints.

bullet_points.title: Option A
bullet_points.description: The simplest path and what it protects.

bullet_points.title: Option B
bullet_points.description: The stronger upside and its cost.

bullet_points.title: Recommendation
bullet_points.description: The criterion that makes the choice defensible.

slides.title: Turn agreement into action
slides.content: End with a small sequence that can be reviewed and improved by the people who own it.

bullet_points.title: Next review
bullet_points.description: Bring the evidence and open questions back.

bullet_points.title: Decision gate
bullet_points.description: Continue, adapt, or stop with a named owner.
